cards.name: Unique Fixed Point
cards.statement_exact: Under Hypotheses~\ref{hyp:H1}--\ref{hyp:H3}, for each $u\in\U$ there exists a unique $f_u^\ast\in\Hilb$ such that $T_u(f_u^\ast)=f_u^\ast$. Moreover, for every $\Psi_0\in\Hilb$, $\lim_{n\to\infty}T_u^n(\Psi_0)=f_u^\ast$.
hidden_assumptions: Banach fixed-point theorem is invoked externally
projection proof relies on Hilbert completeness and strict convexity
cards.domain_of_validity: Hilbert-space transition operator satisfying H1-H3 and strict contraction.
debt_dependencies: review whether projection theorem should explicitly declare H3
reviewer_questions: Should the fixed point be stated as lying in I?
Is H3 sufficiently explicit in the projection dependency?
Is invoking Banach fixed point acceptable without local proof?

cards.name: Conditional Stability of Inverse-Limit Identity
cards.statement_exact: Assume RIG-1 through RIG-5. Then the perturbed inverse limit exists, and there is a constant C_rig>0 depending only on the projection, lifting, and weight controls such that d_H(Id,tilde{Id}) <= C_rig ||eps_bullet||_w in the weighted product metric.
hidden_assumptions: diagonal compactness invoked but compactness is not explicit in RIG-1..RIG-5
Hausdorff distance is well-defined and finite
C_rig existence requires constructive dependency proof
cards.domain_of_validity: Typed admissible perturbation families satisfying RIG-1..RIG-5 plus compactness/well-definedness burden.
reviewer_questions: Does the proof require compactness beyond complete metrics?
Is d_H well-defined for every admitted system?
Should the theorem be renamed as conditional weighted Hausdorff stability?

cards.name: Conditional Non-Simulability of CCR by Finite Simulators
cards.statement_exact: Assume NS-1 through NS-3. Then no simulator in \mathbf{Comp}_{\mathrm{finite}} faithfully realizes a CCR target.
hidden_assumptions: each finite boundedness feature forces loss of at least one NS-1 component
faithful realization is restricted to NS-3
cards.domain_of_validity: CCR targets satisfying NS-1 and finite simulators satisfying NS-2 under faithful simulation criterion NS-3.
reviewer_questions: Is the theorem non-trivial given NS-1 exclusion clauses?
Can compression-loss be decomposed by simulator subtype?
Is there an explicit non-empty model of NS-1?
